attributes.board_name: South Dakota Board of Medical and Osteopathic Examiners

rules.unit: hours of post-graduate studies approved by the board
rules.alternatives: Proof of current NCCPA certification documents compliance with the 30 hours.
rules.notes: Annual renewal; the application must be filed with the board before May 1 each year (ARSD 20:52:01:09). Hours count over the preceding twelve months.
